title: Formation Of Chinan University Students War Time Service Gro

page_data.en:
FM
G. 20M 1 37
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.
S.1, Special Branch. Station,
REPORT
Date... November 15, 37.
Subject... Chinan University Students War Time Service Group.
Made by... D.S. Hocking. ...Forwarded by... C. Crawford.
Acting in accordance with the instructions of the
D.C. (Special Branch) on the attached file, the Chinan
University was visited by the undersigned on November 13
and Mr. Yue Ching Sung, faculty member interviewed. Owing,
he said, to the fact that the faculty body looked with
disfavour upon the activities of the students, regarding the
War Time Service Group, this organization had ceased activities
and was at the present time non-existent.
Copy to Do 13
D. S. Hocking
D. S.
D.C. (Special Branch)
（印：...）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案号
S.1，特别处。分局，
报告
日期……1937年11月15日。
主题……暨南大学学生战时服务团。
制作人……D.S. Hocking。……转呈人……C. Crawford。
根据所附档案中特别处副总监（D.C. (Special Branch)）的指示，具名者于11月13日访问了暨南大学，并约谈了教员岳景松（Yue Ching Sung，音译）先生。他说，由于教职员团体对学生关于战时服务团的活动持不赞成态度，该组织已停止活动，目前不复存在。
抄送 Do 13
D. S. Hocking
D. S.
特别处副总监
（印：...）

FM 2
G. 20M 1-37
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.
S.1, Special Branch. Station
REPORT
Date November 10, 19 37.
Subject Chinan University Students Air Time Service Group (暨南学生战时服务团)
- new body formed.
Made by Clerk Liao Chun- Chien Forwarded by C. [Signature]

Some fifty students of the Chinan University, No.826
Ferry Road, have organized a War Time Service Group in the
school. The Group has for its object the promotion of pro-
paganda in connection with the present crisis and solicitation
of money and articles for the relief of the wounded soldiers
and civilians.
The following is a list of the personnel of the new body:-

| Section | Responsible member |
| :--- | :--- |
| General Affairs Section: | Liu Tsung Ching (刘宗清) |
| | Yih Fen Tsoo (曹法初) |
| Organization Section: | Tong Tseh Tsung (汤执中) |
| | (Tong is the chief promoter |
| | of the Student Circles |
| | National Salvation Association. |
| Communication Section: | Tang Shiao Tung (唐晓东) |
| Contribution Soliciting | |
| Section: | Tong Yih Tse (汤益之) |
| Sewing Section: | Wu Ching Zai (吴庆才) |
| First-Aid Section: | Zung Sien Tseng (郑先整) |
| Propaganda Section: | Keo Tsung An (高整安) |
| Relief Section: | Yih Tun- Ching (叶东青) |

At present the Group is promoting the sale of Liberty
Bonds in the school and raising funds and soliciting cotton
padded vests and gloves from the students for comforts for
the wounded soldiers.
Attached herewith is a copy of the pledge form (together
with translation) issued by the Group.

（批：Include in morning as add that it may be means of securing & residents to place agitation & propaganda leaflets in Settlement）
（印：0063 11 NOV 1937 SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL）
（批：S.1. For attention D.C. 11/11）

Copy to D.C. S.
D.S.
Liao Chungchen
Clerk
11/11
D.C. (Special Branch)

FM 2
G. 20M 1-37
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案号
S.1，特别处。分局
报告
日期 1937年11月10日。
主题 暨南大学学生战时服务团（暨南学生战时服务团）
- 新成立的团体。
制作人 办事员廖春健（Liao Chun-Chien，音译） 转呈人 C. [签名]

位于斐伦路826号的暨南大学约有五十名学生在校内组织了一个战时服务团。该团体的宗旨是宣传与当前危机有关的事项，并为救济伤兵和平民募集捐款及物资。
以下是该新团体的人员名单：-

| 部门 | 负责人 |
| :--- | :--- |
| 总务部： | 刘宗清 (Liu Tsung Ching) |
| | 曹法初 (Yih Fen Tsoo) |
| 组织部： | 汤执中 (Tong Tseh Tsung) |
| | （汤是学生救国会的主要发起人。） |
| 联络部： | 唐晓东 (Tang Shiao Tung) |
| 募捐部： | 汤益之 (Tong Yih Tse) |
| 缝纫部： | 吴庆才 (Wu Ching Zai) |
| 急救部： | 郑先整 (Zung Sien Tseng) |
| 宣传部： | 高整安 (Keo Tsung An) |
| 救济部： | 叶东青 (Yih Tun- Ching) |

目前，该团正在校内推广爱国公债的销售，并向学生募集资金以及征集棉背心和手套，以慰劳伤兵。
随函附上该团发布的誓愿书副本（附译文）。

（批：列入晨报，另加说明，这可能成为确保居民在租界内放置煽动性和宣传性传单的手段）
（印：0063 1937年11月11日 上海公共租界）
（批：S.1. 提请特别处副总监注意 11/11）

抄送 特别处副总监 S.
D.S.
廖春健
办事员
11/11
特别处副总监
